Eligibility is thin (24% breadth) and no one-narrative dominance; China Tech/Platform/EV/Gaming lag deeply. The validated edge here is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so only eligible themes warrant trend-following leans, at low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Diversified Miners (rank #2, score 1.033) actually crosses into eligible=true with durability_bar above ~0.5 and breadth expanding above 0.2 — a confirmed handoff of leadership from Banks would require that eligibility flag plus a durability_bar improvement to at least 0.5 before the next note; until then it remains an unscorable non-eligible challenger, not a trend leader.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the dominant eligible narrative, top-ranked with the highest durability_bar (0.67) in the headlined slot and breadth 0.769, the strongest cohesion among ranked themes. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.79, crowded false), so no size-down caution is triggered. The trend-gate leg (validated risk control) supports holding this as the staying-power leader rather than chasing rank, since its eligibility and durability are the only detector legs that matter here.
theses.dissent: Banks as the leader may already be priced; momentum rank is a focus lens with rank-IC ~0, and rotation breadth is narrow, suggesting leadership is fragile if the Hang Seng regime shifts.
